results.title: 🚨Nigeria 🇳🇬: l’armée de l’air nigériane a mené, le 19 octobre 2026, une frappe contre une position du groupe djihadiste État islamique en Af
results.description: 🚨Nigeria 🇳🇬: l’armée de l’air nigériane a mené, le 19 octobre 2026, une frappe contre une position du groupe djihadiste État islamique en Afrique de l’Ouest (ISWAP), dans la région du lac Tchad. Selon les informations communiquées, plusieurs cadres de l’organisation ont été tués, notamment Jindullah, chargé de la sécurité et proche d’Abu Saleem, ainsi qu’Abul Kissa, membre du conseil consultatif de l’ISWAP.

results.description:
BREAKING: Yesterday afternoon, rival bandit groups clashed in Mada, Gusau LGA of Zamfara State, with reports indicating that notorious bandit leader Kachallah Dogo Baldu was killed by Aleru’s men alongside several of his fighters.

Reports from the area suggest the fighting was still ongoing as at this morning, raising concerns about further casualties as the two groups continue to battle each other.

results.title: BREAKING: Today, youths in Gwashi, Bukkuyum LGA of Zamfara State, chased Deputy Governor Mani Malam Mummuni and his entourage during a visit
results.description:
BREAKING: Today, youths in Gwashi, Bukkuyum LGA of Zamfara State, chased Deputy Governor Mani Malam Mummuni and his entourage during a visit to commiserate with the community over bandit attacks and aid victims.

The youths, angered by the continued atrocities in Gwashi and neighbouring communities, reportedly protested the persistent insecurity. His security personnel also fled and leave their vehicle behind as tensions escalated.

Photos of the incident are also in the comment section.

The incident reflects the growing frustration of residents who continue to live in fear of bandit attacks.

NB: Below is the short video of the incident

results.title: Fear is growing along the Gusau–Dansadau road in Zamfara State as bandit threats force residents to leave their vehicles at home, disrupting
results.description:
Fear is growing along the Gusau–Dansadau road in Zamfara State as bandit threats force residents to leave their vehicles at home, disrupting transportation and business activities.

In another worrying development, bandits reportedly invaded Yar Gada community in Magami Ward, Gusau LGA, and set residents vehicles on fire.

Residents are now concerned about further attacks following threats reportedly linked to the burning of as many as 250 vehicles in the axis.

How long will people continue to live in fear and abandon their daily activities before the government and security agencies take decisive action to protect lives and property?

results.title: SAD NEWS: This morning, bandits reportedly killed two people along the Adafka–Duhuwa road in Bukkuyum LGA, Zamfara State.
results.description:
SAD NEWS: This morning, bandits reportedly killed two people along the Adafka–Duhuwa road in Bukkuyum LGA, Zamfara State.

This afternoon, bandits also blocked a road from Lauwali Junction-Gusau town in Gusau LGA and shot a driver.

How long must residents and road users continue to live in fear before the authorities take decisive action to protect innocent lives?

results.title: TROOPS KILL 2 LAKURAWA FIGHTERS, RECOVER 4 AK-47 RIFLES IN SOKOTO Troops of Operation Fansan Yamma killed two suspected Lakurawa terrorists
results.description:
TROOPS KILL 2 LAKURAWA FIGHTERS, RECOVER 4 AK-47 RIFLES IN SOKOTO

Troops of Operation Fansan Yamma killed two suspected Lakurawa terrorists during clearance operations at Waria Forest and Sarma Village in Sokoto on October 15. The operation also yielded four AK-47 rifles, eight motorcycles, ammunition, four magazines and communication equipment.
